subject: Invoice routing & billing contact — portal credentialing vs email copies
messages:
From: Laura Jennings <laura.jennings@acmecorp.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@acmecorp.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice delivery and PO capture for Redwood usage

Hi Vivek,

We reviewed the billing details for the pilot account and have two quick questions before we wire the first payment:  

1) How will invoices be delivered going forward — will Redwood post invoices in a vendor portal or email a signed PDF to our AP email? We need a clearly auditable PDF with invoice number and VAT breakdown.
2) Our AP requires that each invoice include a PO number. Is there a preferred place for us to provide PO_789453 so it appears on the invoice automatically (portal profile vs adding it to email replies)?

I've attached the PO for reference. If portal onboarding is required, please send instructions and an admin invite; otherwise confirm who we should CC on invoice emails.

Thanks,
Laura Jennings
Director, Finance Ops
Acme Media Inc.
(attachment: PO_789453.pdf)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Laura Jennings <laura.jennings@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery and PO capture for Redwood usage

Hi Laura — thanks for the clear questions and for sending the PO. Short answer: we support both patterns and can do a hybrid to match your AP controls. Details below and a recommended next step.

Options (pros/cons):
- Portal-first (recommended for recurring volume): we post invoices as signed PDFs into the customer portal and can push an email notification to finance@acmecorp.com. Pros: authoritative archive, programmatic retrieval (webhook/API), auto-population of billing profile fields (including PO). Cons: requires a one-time admin invite and credentialing.
- Email-first (simple): we send signed PDF invoices to the AP inbox and include VAT line items and invoice metadata. Pros: minimal setup. Cons: harder to automate ingestion and de-duplicate invoices if you have multiple recipients.

What I need from you to proceed:
- Confirm which option you prefer (portal vs email).
- If portal: confirm the billing admin (name + email) who should receive the invite so we can pre-fill the billing profile and map PO fields.
- If email: confirm which exact email address(es) should receive PDFs and whether to include a secondary CC for reconciliation.

If helpful, Ben can kick off a portal invite and send a short step-by-step PDF. If you prefer email-first for the pilot, we can send the next invoice to finance@acmecorp.com and include the PO on the invoice metadata.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Jennings <laura.jennings@acmecorp.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@acmecorp.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 13:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery and PO capture for Redwood usage

Thanks Vivek — for the pilot let's do email-first to finance@acmecorp.com, with a portal enrollment to follow if volume increases. Two requests for the email copies:  

1) Please ensure the invoice PDF includes the PO number in the header (PO: 789453) and a VAT breakdown line.
2) Keep Kimberly Park (kimberly@acmecorp.com) on CC for reconciliation.

If you can send the first invoice to finance@acmecorp.com with PO 789453 included, we'll process payment. We'll take the portal invite in parallel — please send the onboarding doc so our AP admin can accept the invite later.

Best,
Laura
(attachment: PO_789453.pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Laura Jennings <laura.jennings@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@acmecorp.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery and PO capture for Redwood usage

Hi Laura — looping in Marissa (Billing) to action the email-first invoice and to provision a portal invite in parallel. Summary of next steps from our side:  

1) Marissa will generate the current month invoice PDF and include PO: 789453 and a VAT breakdown. You should receive that at finance@acmecorp.com within 2 business hours.
2) We'll CC Kimberly as requested on the outgoing invoice.
3) Marissa will issue a portal admin invite to the AP admin once you confirm the account holder's name (you can reply with that when ready). The invite flow is optional and only needed if you want the machine-readable API and webhook delivery.
4) Attached is a short portal-invite-instructions.pdf that explains the onboarding steps and the field where a PO will be captured on the billing profile.

If any of the PO formatting needs change (prefix, hyphens), let us know and we'll reflect it on future invoices.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Billing Ops 
Redwood Inference
(attachment: portal-invite-instructions.pdf)
